recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow build-scope clarification that completes the current FHIR-16912 application without duplicating or refactoring the existing terminology examples.
issue_request: FHIR-16912 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocab change request asking for clearer real examples of the difference between Extensible and Preferred bindings; the resolution was to add an example and copy explanatory material from extensible-binding guidance.
initial_application: The example page was created by the same-change-family FHIR-17402 application in commit 1c42a3bd45d with Extensible and Preferred examples. FHIR-16912 itself was applied in commit e5f6daf5a7, which changed source/terminologies.html links/headings so the existing Extensible and Preferred examples were more obvious.
additional_context: The terminology page set remains active current source: source/fhir.ini maps resourceType to terminologies, source/terminologies.html links from the binding-strength guidance to source/terminologies-binding-examples.html, and later FHIR-34005/FHIR-38967 work maintained the same binding-strength example area. Community searches found no direct conflicting Zulip or Confluence discussion for FHIR-16912.
